question: Preservation of a declared source-grounded untimed token transition model, not superiority of biological vocabulary or full cellular dynamics
source_selection: Six fixed official directional events selected before outcomes: LDH71849/70510, MCT373875/373867, GAPDH70449/70482
event_local_grid: For each event, enumerate every ternary assignment to all its input/output/catalyst places. All unrelated places are zero. If a chemically identical place in another compartment is outside that support, repeat every assignment with those remote counterpart places set to two. No other initial states are added after seeing results.
generic_fairness: The competent generic incidence interpreter receives all the same participant coefficients, identities, compartment distinctions and active-catalyst assertions. No comparative compute-efficiency claim is made.
concurrency_grid: Every ordered pair of the six events under three initial states: componentwise maximum of the two reactant demands, their componentwise sum, and all metabolite counts zero. Every catalyst used by the pair has one active-role token. Compare declared sequential atomic commit order with independent initial-snapshot approvals.
missingness_policy: Unknown required inventory or output baseline is UNRESOLVED unless a known absent prerequisite already proves BLOCK. Unknown rates and completion times are always UNRESOLVED.
stop_rule: Run this fixed grid, batches and traces once after freeze, retain every mismatch and generic tie, repair implementation bugs only with an explicit versioned correction receipt; do not optimize tasks or initial conditions after results.
eligible_conclusion: Bounded compiler/semantic fidelity to a declared model, with separately proved conditional preservation; not biological validation, TORUS closure proof, efficacy against providers, novel mathematical theory or superiority over an equivalent generic algorithm.
